_comment: The DEFINITION of the production bin grid: the parameters it is derived with, the corpus it is derived from, and a content digest of the result. This file is the single source of those parameters -- helix.data.bins reads its defaults here, and scripts/derive_coeff_bins.py takes its argparse defaults from those, so the numbers live in one place.
name: coeff_bins_r2_run0027575715

corpus._basis_digest_note: Checkable BEFORE deriving, and catches the pre-tau/r1 confusion. It does NOT identify which run: basis_digest hashes the DSP recipe, so all eight r1 runs share it.

_rerecord_note: 2026-10-26: derived for r2 with the r1 grid's parameters (S3DF, job 42010766). r2's inner edges sit a median 0.35/0.46/0.64/0.98 local bin widths (A4/D4/D3/D2; max 2.0) from r1 v2's, against 0.16 between r1 runs, so the r1 grid (coeff_bins_r1_tau05_run0027575715_v3, NERSC) does not describe r2. Models trained on r1's grid are not value-comparable with ones trained on this. basis_digest is r2's after its migration to helix-coeff-2 (the gate's removal schema; the coefficients, and so this grid, are unchanged).
